postman.com.company_overview: Postman is an API platform for building and using APIs. Postman simplifies each step of the API lifecycle and streamlines collaboration so you can create better APIs—faster.
postman.com.target_audience: Developers, API teams, and enterprises building and managing APIs.

supabase.com.company_overview: Supabase is an open-source, fully managed Postgres platform that provides developers with a complete backend, including database, authentication, storage, and real-time features. It offers scalable, secure infrastructure for building applications from prototypes to production.
supabase.com.target_audience: Developers, startups, agencies, enterprises, and innovation teams building AI and other applications.

vapi.ai.company_overview: Vapi is a voice AI platform that offers usage-based and enterprise pricing for call, SMS, and chat services. It provides scalable, secure solutions with options for HIPAA compliance and zero data retention.
